svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Ten steps (0–9) · two quality gates · one approval checkpoint · intent × rigor × scale. Committing is a rhythm that crosses every step, never a step of its own.
the wave shape locks here, and the run goes quiet
· Step 3 ends at one checkpoint — one, not a series of small confirmations
· the user approves the plan, the slices, and the locked Verification Matrix
· a rigor floor is advice: an override below it is accepted, never refused, and
· below this line the run is unattended, within the stop-and-wake rules
WALK-AWAY — UNATTENDED WITHIN THE STOP-AND-WAKE RULES (STEPS 4–9)
roughly one checkpoint commit per step, and every one of them passes canonical-sdlc-evidence-gate.sh. Not a numbered step — a rhythm that runs the length of the row above.
Update ## SDLC State BEFORE staging: the gate reads the file on disk, never the diff. There is no commit: field to fill in — the SHA lives in git.
scale: task — the whole row, compressed
The ten steps collapse into one line each in a ## Tasks ledger,
and the evidence gate reads current: T<n> instead of a step number.
Nothing is dropped; the artifact is smaller, and the gates still bind.
An epic short-circuits any intent after Step 3: it emits epic.spec and
epic.plan, carves waves, and hands each wave its own run of this row.
Steps 4–9 belong to the waves, never to the epic itself.
A spike ships no code, so it has no plan file, no worktree, no gates, and
no commits to the integration branch. It produces one writeup, at
<docs-root>/spikes/<slug>.md, and the decision it bought is the deliverable.
THE TRIPLE — THREE INDEPENDENT DIALS, DECLARED AT STEP 0 AND SHOWN BACK TO THE USER BEFORE ANYTHING RUNS
The deltas are real, not labels: bugfix's Step-4 failing test
IS the repro; refactor's spec is "behavior preserved", and a
new criterion means reclassify as build; incident-response
triages first, writes an RCA at Step 7, and floors at audited.
Each tier contains the one before it. audited is the tier that
adds the mandatory independent critic at Step 6 — the agent
whose job is to falsify the claim that this is ready to merge.
Floors advise; they never refuse. The user's lower value is
taken, after being told what evidence it gives up.
Scale changes the artifact, not the discipline. A task keeps a
ledger line; a wave keeps the full spec-and-plan pair; an epic
keeps only what outlives its waves.
A barred intent × scale cell is rejected outright at Step 0 —
that one the override DSL cannot buy.
red = approval checkpoint, and the walk-away boundary it opens
grey = context that shapes the row rather than sitting in it
composed SVG — this file is the source · pinned by tests/diagrams.test.sh
